title: Free Human Theme Kit: take in the design system and load the theme into Frequency (website, Spotlight, Space page, email, starter kits)
detail: The Free Human Movement design system (code id free-human, editor theme FreeHuman) goes through docs/DESIGN-SYSTEM-INTAKE.md: rules, inventory, tokens, copy and a baseline of known gaps that only shrinks. The kit is then built the way Temple was: foundation and tokens, assets, chrome, eleven blocks, Home and Calendar pages, four emails, Spotlight layouts, thirteen starter kits and a /themes page on the Nocturne layout. Owner ruling 2026-10-29: load the theme only. No Free Human Movement Space or site data is created or seeded. Photo rights in design/photos/README.md are unresolved: the copyrighted ones must not ship in anything a Space receives until cleared. Built so far (2026-10-29): chrome, eleven blocks (Home, Calendar hero, Calendar, Year Wheel), the Home and Calendar pages, Spotlight preset and email surface from the flat token set, thirteen starter kits (free-human-<niche>, without the Books and Speaking sections that name one person), registration and live publishing. Still open: dedicated Spotlight layouts and four themed emails (need Claude Design screens; the handoff has none), the /themes page (theme pages thread), full-page design passes at 1440/1920/2000. Open concerns: photo rights uncleared (32 photos); honey profile contrast 3.5:1; event kind is inferred from the title (no tag field); the Calendar closing band is not in the handoff's block list (optional closingTitle); Calendar defaultView is month where the handoff says list; the wheel covers 2026 to 2028 only (hand-entered eclipse and retrograde tables); the wheel thread is not responsive on phones, as in the design. Owner lifted the no-Space ruling 2026-10-29 (21:43Z): the Free Human Movement Space (slug freehumanmovement, owner danieltyack, Business comped, free-human theme) and its Space Spotlight are seeded by one guarded SQL transaction printed by scripts/render/free-human-space-sql.render.tsx (lib/sites/free-human-site.ts is the data): cover, logo, about, four programs, the design's 26 gatherings on the Space's own Circle, the Home and Calendar website and an eight-block Spotlight whose data blocks read the Space. The theme stays out of every picker. After Publish, scripts/attach-site-subdomain.mjs freehumanmovement attaches the address.

verify.evidence: Registered and private (held out of every picker like House of Fates), thirteen starter kits load. Open until the four themed emails and the Spotlight layouts ship; both wait on Claude Design screens (the handoff has neither) and the /themes page waits on the theme pages thread.
